title: forced-random pedestal validation of P04m pretrigger abstention

follow_up_ticket.title: P04n2: acquire or mirror true forced-random B-stack pedestal ROOT for P04m support veto closure
follow_up_ticket.body: Question: can a dedicated forced/random B-stack pedestal acquisition, mirrored into data/root/root with trigger metadata, validate the P04m high-pretrigger support veto without using physics-event pretrigger proxies? Expected information gain: separates true electronics pedestal disturbances from duplicate-readout overfitting and decides whether the veto may be promoted from diagnostic to operational.
